audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows disagreed with their own why-text: levels 4-5 and 6 read Skill while whys[3] says 'the lane phase is his' and whys[4] says the level-6 window 'belongs to him'; two items read Jax while whys[6] says 'dead even'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill/Jax/Jax/Sylas/Sylas/Jax/Skill at 50.68% over 2557 games — your window is levels 2-3 and the first item, his is 4-6 while he maxes poke and holds Hijack.
audit.corrected: Rows set to Skill / Jax / Jax / Sylas / Sylas / Jax / Skill in both layers, with levels 4-5 and 6 dropped to 4/10.

audit.why: Four spikes present and the level-6 one is correctly inverted — Hijack steals your ultimate, so 6 is his spike, not yours. Worth adding that Hijack is 80/55/30s: at rank 3 it is back up roughly as fast as your own 90s ultimate, which is why the late game flattens.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries the 80/55/30s Hijack so 'all-in when his R is down' has a real number behind it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Abduct a chain stun in five places — 'his dash + stun (recast pull)', 'Land the E2 chain stun to pin you'. Abduct does not stun and does not pull you: it pulls SYLAS to the enemy it hits. The E carries no hard-CC in Riot's text or the kit flags.
audit.why: Riot's Abscond/Abduct text: Sylas dashes to a location, and can recast to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits — 13/12/11/10/9s, 400 range, projectile. That reframes the whole matchup: he has no lane CC to pin you for a combo, so your Counter Strike stun is uncontested and the real threat is spell poke plus Hijack. Also worth stating in the reader's favour: Petricite Burst empowers his basic attacks, and those ARE attacks, so Counter Strike does blank them.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[1] all re-state Abduct as a self-pull with no stun, with its real cooldown.
sources: brief enemyKit E text, cd 13/12/11/10/9, flags (no hardCC)

audit.whatIsWrong: The tracked cooldown had no number, and Hijack — the cooldown that actually decides every all-in after 6 — was not tracked at all.
audit.why: Abscond/Abduct is 13s at rank 1; Hijack is 80/55/30s and at rank 3 comes back faster than your own ultimate, so 'wait for his R' stops being a plan late.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Abscond / Abduct's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: He maxes Chain Lash poke and ranks Kingslayer's missing-health heal — out-sustained, this stretch is his unless your E is up.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Sylas's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Hijack steals YOUR ultimate for its Armor/MR, so 6 is his all-in window — never throw your R first into an even-HP fight.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Sylas carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Both scale: his Chain Lash poke, Kingslayer heal and a stolen ult make it dead even — all-in only when Hijack is down.

edits.before: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: The Abduct recast pulls him to you — it is no stun. Bait the 13s dash, then commit.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: 13/12/11/10/9s — the recast pulls HIM to you, it does not stun you. Bait the dash out, then commit. - Hijack: 80/55/30s, so by rank 3 it is almost always up. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Sylas's Abscond / Abduct: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. When it is down — E-counter his KA, Q-W burst.
edits.after: Abduct pulls Sylas to you, it does not stun you. Counter Strike does blank his Petricite Burst autos — punish the dash.

edits.before: Land the E2 chain stun to pin you, then ult to steal your Grandmaster at Arms at the level-6 all-in
edits.after: Chain-pull himself onto you off Abduct, then ult to steal your R for its Armor/MR at the level-6 all-in

notes: Real mechanical error killed: the page described Abduct as a chain stun that pins you. Riot's text has it pulling Sylas to the enemy he hits, with no CC — the kit carries no hardCC flag on E either. That changes how the lane is played, since it means he has no way to lock you for a combo. suspectNames entry 'Counter Strike's' is a false positive. Content layer says 'Grandmaster at Arms' for Jax's R where the full layer says 'Grandmaster's Might' — champion-wide inconsistency, flagged not fixed.
